summary.text: Josh Kimbrell is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 11 in Spartanburg County.
His official page lists his occupation as commercial real estate sales and leasing, and his committees include Judiciary.

paragraphs.text: Kimbrell was born on December 18, 1984, in Spartanburg.
His official page lists a B.A. from North Greenville University in 2007 and study at the Gardner-Webb School of Business.
He chaired the Spartanburg County Republican Party in 2017 and 2018 and has been a vice chairman of Honor Flight Upstate since 2019.
His committee assignments are Agriculture and Natural Resources, Family and Veterans' Services, Judiciary, Labor, Commerce and Industry, and Medical Affairs.
